skipped_reason.description: Why nothing was indexed; absent when chunks were stored. mime_not_allowed: the content is not UTF-8 text, contains a NUL byte, or its type is not in embeddings.policy.mime_allowlist. too_large: larger than embeddings.policy.max_bytes (text) or embeddings.extractor.max_bytes (content routed to the extractor), the extractor's output exceeds embeddings.extractor.max_text_bytes, or the text would produce more than the 2000-chunk cap. already_indexed: the CID has index entries and force was false. not_a_file: the CID is a UnixFS directory or another non-file node. empty: the file is empty or only whitespace, so there is no chunk to embed. not_local: the read was offline and the file's blocks are not on the node; indexing never fetches from the network (ADR-0011 V4). kind_not_enabled: every stage of the content's kind is off (for example an image with extractor OCR off and no describer covering images), or an extractor is configured and the content is of a listed kind with a binary signature and its type is not in embeddings.policy.mime_allowlist (for example a PDF). UTF-8 text with no binary signature (JSON, CSV, XML, HTML) stays on the native path and is skipped mime_not_allowed when not allowlisted. extractor_unavailable: the kind needs the extractor and none is configured or it is unreachable. extraction_failed: the extractor could not produce text (for example a missing model with downloads disabled). describer_not_configured: the kind is covered only by the describer and no embeddings.describer block exists or its kinds list does not name the kind. chunks_indexed is 0 whenever skipped_reason is present.
